'''Udo Lin Xoir''' was a lead analyst of an [[Unidentified Iokath species|unknown species]] from [[Iokath]] who worked with master designer [[Vel Jyc Boer]], someone who Udo Lin Xoir greatly admired. Udo Lin Xoir worked on [[Test environment WL428T73]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Udo Lin Xoir is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' in the codex entry 'History of Iokath: Entry 3'.<ref name="Codex" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1stm}}
